entities.name: Géza Polónyi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Géza Polónyi was a Hungarian politician and jurist, who served as Minister of Justice between 1906 and 1907. He was a major politician of the Independence Party. He actively took part in the filibuster against the government in 1903. After his resignation he criticized the governing party many times. During the Hungarian Soviet Republic he was interned.

entities.name: Géza Polónyi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Géza Polónyi was a Hungarian politician and jurist, who served as Minister of Justice between 1906 and 1907. He was a major politician of the Independence Party. He actively took part in the filibuster against the government in 1903. After his resignation he criticized the governing party many times. During the Hungarian Soviet Republic he was interned.
